note: This is a REVIEW ARTIFACT, not an auto-merge, mirroring the existing convention in mrsilent_bridge/discovery_data/ and the explicit rule in mrsilent_bridge/capability_registry.py: 'nothing in this project auto-registers a capability without a human having reviewed and added a JSON entry.' Written by the OMNISIM_OMNI_ORACLE_GOD_MODE_V1 campaign (2026-09-02) because mrsilent_bridge/registry_data/capabilities.json has zero entries for either 'omnisim' or 'oracle' as of this writing (verified live via registry_search and capability_status), despite both being real, tested, running components. A human should review these and, if accurate, copy them into mrsilent_bridge/registry_data/capabilities.json's "entries" array themselves.

proposed_entries.purpose: Governed what-if / decision-support scenario analysis via 3 transparent heuristic/arithmetic engines (decision_heuristic, resource_model, comparative_scenario). Not a predictive model.
available_actions: request_scenario(question, assumptions=None, options=None, *, scenario_type=..., variables=..., constraints=..., requested_outputs=...)
proposed_entries.io_contract: in: question (str) + scenario_type + variables/constraints (dict); out: structured result with scenario_outputs, uncertainty, risks, limitations, receipt path
proposed_entries.cost_class: free_local (pure Python, no external calls, no paid compute)
proposed_entries.validation_method: omnisim/tests/test_request_scenario.py (4/4 passing, independently re-run 2026-09-02); live systemd timer omnisim-loop.timer
known_callers: services/th3_mcp/tools.py (hardcoded direct import, not via this registry, as of 2026-09-02)
proposed_entries.evidence_basis: omnisim/reports/omnisim_v1_certification_20260831.json (self-reported, disclaimer-qualified) + independent re-run of its test suite by this campaign (2026-09-02) + live canary via divisions/omnioracle/api/request_oracle.py's also_run_omnisim_scenario ensemble path

proposed_entries.purpose: Canonical read/aggregate (and opt-in generate) facade over the 27-module OmniOracle forecast/consensus pipeline (probabilistic_forecast_engine, consensus_intelligence_layer, recursive_simulation_engine, forecast_ledger, forecast_outcome_verifier, etc). Added 2026-09-02 -- this pipeline had no function-callable request/response API before this file.
available_actions: request_oracle(domain, question=None, *, mode='read'|'generate', seed=None, min_evidence=0, also_run_omnisim_scenario=None)
proposed_entries.io_contract: in: domain (str, must be non-empty), mode, min_evidence; out: status (ok|insufficient_evidence), observations (real counts), synthetic_projection (labeled synthetic, from unseeded-random underlying engines), receipt path
proposed_entries.cost_class: free_local (pure Python + subprocess to local scripts, no external calls, no paid compute)
dependencies: omnioracle-continuous-daemon.timer (systemd, live, populates the evidence this facade reads)
proposed_entries.validation_method: divisions/omnioracle/tests/test_request_oracle.py (19/19 passing incl. adversarial/edge cases, 2026-09-02); live canary run 2026-09-02 (mode=generate + omnisim ensemble)
known_limitations: confidence/probability_band/risk_factor fields are synthetic placeholders from unseeded random sampling in the underlying engines, not calibrated forecasts -- see module docstring
real_signal_connector has zero live external data connectors (all blueprint_ready, live_collection_enabled=false)
forecast_outcome_verifier will not score reliability until real outcomes are confirmed (real_outcome_required=true)
not wired into services/th3_mcp/tools.py as of 2026-09-02 (that file is owned by a separate concurrently-active session; see EXTERNAL_ACTIVE_SESSION_DEPENDENCY in this campaign's final report)
proposed_entries.evidence_basis: divisions/omnioracle/final_godmode_audit/reports/omnioracle_final_godmode_gap_audit_v1.json (2026-05-07, honest_status=TRUE_GOD_MODE_FOUNDATION_LOCKED_NEEDS_LONG_TERM_REALITY_CALIBRATION) + this campaign's independent code review, test suite, and live canary (2026-09-02)
